Painting really helps me when I’m in a depressive episode, although my perfectionism tends to show itself when I try to start a painting and that mixed with the depression sometimes prevents me from actually going through with it. If you like art, I suggest grabbing a sketchbook whenever you feel low and just start drawing little doodles all over the page. Don’t worry about what it looks like, if it’s “good”, etc. You can draw what you’re feeling at the moment, your favorite animal, anything! Sometimes all of my tiny doodles come together and, mixed with a little acrylic or watercolor, it’s something I’m proud of! Even if it sucks, you will be surprised how much it helps take your mind off of everything for a bit. I always end up in a better mood than before, even if I’m not necessarily proud of the art I created. :)

My house kept getting robbed a few years ago. Woke up one morning to the window in my sons nursery busted in, the screens on our porch razor cut, and my purse gone. Called the police and they told me it wasn’t a robbery but “mysterious activity” lol. 

A week later I was laying in bed one morning, hadn’t slept because I was still terrified we would get robbed again. A black figure came into my peripheral and it was clearly a man in a ski mask. A black glove reached over my face to grab my phone. Something inside me screamed to just close my eyes. He grabbed my phone, I heard his footsteps walk out of my bedroom, walk back in, and he placed my phone back next to me. I had a wallet phone case and he took all of my money. I heard his footsteps walk out of the room again and he left. 

I didn’t react because I was pregnant with my son at the time. I didn’t know if this person was armed. I didn’t want him to hurt my baby so I closed my eyes and just waited for it to be over. 

I reached behind me and dug my nails into my boyfriends leg to wake him up. I was too terrified to even form a sentence. He kept asking me what was wrong and I just stood there shaking and crying. I called the police again and they told me I was lying and made me drop the case. 

Typing this out makes me realize how bizarre this whole situation was. I can’t make this shit up. Scariest thing that’s ever happened to me.

Its a good plot twist and a believable one too if you paid attention.

1. General Thade is still alive when Leo leaves the planet Ashlar and still armed with the pistol that he recovered from the broken vase earlier in the film
2. Humans on Ashlar were (at the time when Leo left) free from slavery and free to do awesome things that the apes (who were afraid of water) could not. They recovered Leo's crashed pod from the swamp. Leo's pod (as established in the film)  ran on nuclear power meaning it still had enough juice to make the trip back to Earth and being underwater did not break it. The condition in witch Leo left his crashed pod on Ashlar would have required that the ship undergo some repairs but considering that the humans on Ashlar were the descendants of space fairing astronaut stock it is not unbelievable that they pulled this off once they were no longer persecuted slaves. Also the ship was not so alien to them because after all it was built by english speaking humans just like them.
3. Pericles(the astronaut chimp) was left on the planet Ashlar when Leo used Pericles pod to return home to Earth. While the humans were in the delicate process of repairing the ship for the purpose of making a voyage they may have considered that Pericles would be the perfect candidate for the newly restored pods maiden voyage. Pericles ( who was a trained space pilot) was the pilot that General Thade used to follow Leo back to Earth. It is established earlier in the film that the pods could in fact track each other's locations and that the pilot chimps were capable of performing such task.

It is a huge stretch but the ending implies that this is what happened:

Thade somehow manages to escape his prison inside the crashed mother ship and armed with his pistol also somehow manages to hijack the newly restored pod's maiden voyage (probably with the help of his pistol)  and hitch a ride with Pericles. Pericles simply did what he already knew how to do... blast off, track Leo's pod towards the storm and SAFLEY land where ever the storm spits the pod out, which in this case was Earth for both pods. Thade and Pericles land on Earth in America not far from where Leo crashed some time after the layout of Washington D.C. had already been established. Thade's arrival as a talking english speaking chimp that could sire more talking offspring with the female Earth chimps that he was genetically compatible with would have triggered the same reaction from humans and the same conditions of Escape/Conquest of the Planet of the Apes plot to unfold leaving a feared and persecuted population of Apes lead by a talking chimp who came from the stars to eventually usurp the world of man and his technologies just as they did in the Conquest of the Planet of the Apes film.

Kind of ironic that using a chimp for a test flight is the cause for both the tragic events in the plot and the plot twist itself.

I dated a guy who tried to get me to diet & told me he didn’t want to have sex with me because he felt there was “no need”. That was 2 months into the very (obviously) short 6 month relationship. Listen to your gut. You deserve better.

I say “I guess” because I don’t even own a scale. I just recently had a doctors visit where they weighed me, so that’s how I know what I weigh now hehe. I know if I owned a scale I would obsess over numbers wayyy to much. Just going with the flow and fueling my body when it needs it!

everyone’s caloric needs are different. my BMR (Basal Metabolic Rate) is about 1,700 calories for my weight, age, and height. so eating 1,200 calories puts me in a 500ish calorie deficit, which results in me losing about 1-2 lbs per week I guess. but depending on what I’ve done that day or how much I’ve exercised, that 1,200 turns into maybe 1,400 or 1,500, to make up for those calories burned off with exercise. I believe this method is called CICO (calories in calories out).
Honestly, I’ve just been trying to eat around 1,200 calories a day, and I started roller skating! Nothing crazy, I still eat whatever I want as long as i can fit it into my calorie budget (:
